review.contactTimeLimit: Contact labels are nominal six-second bins; selected frames may lie near each bin midpoint. Native photographs are separately extracted at the exact seek times recorded in the manifest.
review.exitReview: Every second from 474 to 522 seconds was re-extracted; the initial six-second contacts omitted the 502-505 second washroom turn. Exact native frames were then checked.

observations.observed: Aluminum diamond/checkerplate walkway around shiny round stainless tanks; guardrail along the open edge, short access stairs to the green process floor. Tank tops have circular manway lids and clamps; prominent ribbed gray vertical motor/gear assemblies above perforated cylindrical shaft guards. Parallel polished pipes run overhead and against the pale cream panel wall.
observations.limit: Platform width, elevation and tank diameters are reconstructed proportions, not measurements. Upper views and later under-platform views belong to the same tank bank.

observations.observed: At 269.5 seconds a sharp paper operating label reads 혼합/살균 탱크 1. The next filmed lid at 294.5 seconds carries a corresponding label ending in tank 2, with the same motor/mesh-guard construction. Lower views show dished tank bottoms, stainless legs, outlet valves and shared service runs beneath the same platform.
observations.corroboratingPlan: First-half reviewer independently reads the photographed 75–78 second lighting/layout drawing as a five-tank row 카제인, 호모믹스, 호모믹스, 오일, 열수T, with S-1 at the return: six tanks total. Yellow numbered circles on that drawing denote 250W metal-halide lamps, not tanks.
observations.limit: The six functional names are drawing labels, not six readable video nameplates. Do not create extra tanks from repeated top/bottom views, or count lamp symbols as tanks.

observations.observed: Tall pale-cream metal control cabinet bank beside the platform. Visible HMI screen, analog round meters, rows of small digital controllers and red rotary switches; a black-framed paper chart recorder and lower black control module. Posted documents cover some cabinet doors.
observations.limit: Displayed values, loop numbering and operating state are not transcribed or inferred. Repeated close views are one cabinet bank.

observations.observed: One large rectangular stainless machine with a directly visible 균질기 label. Small blue/orange upper control region, pressure gauges, upright adjustment handles, multiple bolted front pump heads and a large round front cover. Located on the floor beside the tank bank and yellow-covered window region.
observations.limit: Make, capacity and pressure values are not readable.

observations.observed: One visible gray horizontal electric motor with bright yellow coupling guard on a pale rectangular base, polished sanitary pump casing and upright process pipe connections.
observations.limit: Only this clearly separated yellow-guard assembly is counted here; this is not a count of every motor glimpsed beneath the process platform.

observations.observed: One small vertical polished cylindrical vessel on three feet, clamped removable lid, lid handle and short top valve lever; side sanitary piping and red/blue valve handles. Stands beside the tank outlets and drain channel.
observations.limit: Filter/pot appearance only; filtration function, contents and nominal volume are not confirmed.

observations.observed: Long perforated trench-drain cover along the tank front, low stainless horizontal pipe runs, flexible lines, wall blue service pipe, red and blue lever handles. Green epoxy floor has worn red strips and patches. Several vertical outlet pipes have small perforated protective metal covers.
observations.limit: Hidden pipe destinations, flow direction and fluid identity are not inferred from color. Floor wear is represented schematically.

observations.observed: Bagged material on pallets, yellow-green forklift and a stainless powder-input station: square table with round hopper, horizontal cylindrical lower assembly and sanitary connections. A blue-lined open cylindrical waste/container stands in front.
observations.limit: Treat this as the same powder-input zone seen earlier, pending first-half match; not evidence of a second independent powder line. Bags and forklift are context objects, not fixed process equipment or inventory counts.

observations.observed: Camera approaches a stainless portal from the green process floor, then traverses a narrow metal-lined air shower with circular air nozzles inset in its walls and a grating/threshold floor. Nearby red fire extinguisher at the process-side wall.
observations.limit: Tunnel dimensions and individual nozzle count are representative. No closed solid end wall is supported: this is the walked-through route.

observations.observed: Beyond the air shower, two round stainless handwash basins with curved taps, wall-mounted green/white dispensers, a floor/mat change with shoes/slippers, and a bank of small gray lockers plus tall garment cabinets below a dark sloping staircase soffit. The posted clothing guide reads 생산1팀 2파트. Light tile ceiling and yellow-covered window.
observations.limit: Small locker tags contain personal names and are not transcribed. Cabinet/locker compartment count is representative. Existing stair geometry must be reused rather than duplicated.

observations.observed: The camera turns off the narrow green-floor entrance corridor into a washroom. Pale ivory ceramic wall tiles with a decorative horizontal border, diagonal beige floor tiles, white paper-towel dispenser, horizontal metal rail and blue-lined waste bin by the door. Two white porcelain urinal fixtures are visible between three dark-brown curved-top privacy dividers. No-smoking sign on the wall; brown slippers at the threshold.
observations.limit: The full fixture inventory, any seated toilet cubicles and washroom measurements are not filmed clearly. Door adjacency to the entry corridor is direct; model position and partition extents are reconstructed against the plan.

observations.observed: Large vertical dark handles and electronic locking hardware on a framed double glass entry. Final exterior has pale cream horizontal cladding, a thick concrete canopy, narrow windows, green safety sign and the same glass entry. No additional interior department is established by the blurred small exterior plate.
observations.limit: The camera reflection is not an additional person fixture. Hardware is static; no access-control system integration is implied.

route.limit: Fast camera rotation at 441–459 seconds limits precise doorway registration.

Handwash and shoe-change area, stair-under lockers, inner glass partition door

Vestibule beside existing green stairs; controlled double-glass door at 509-510s, then exterior concrete canopy.

registration.basis: Root registers the filmed rooms against the photographed current equipment/light layout and exterior anchor doors; native video confirms adjacency rather than measured coordinates.
registration.confirmedConnectivity: Outer controlled double glass entry -> vestibule (stairs/lockers south, handwash north) -> straight aligned air shower -> process room. A northbound side corridor from the vestibule has a west-side washroom door. First air-shower visit165-170 did not traverse the chamber.
limits: Indoor GPS and camera direction are not reliable equipment survey points.
Historical A013 43×35m outer envelope does not prove current room uses.
Exact room widths, apparatus offsets and clearances are reconstructed proportions.
